payload.title: Deliver shared editorial policy to canned workers and assignment context APIs
payload.description: Feature: Shared worker policy. Scenario: Policy before research. Given a live research assignment, when its worker is dispatched, then the shared editorial context enters the prompt before source research. Scenario: Current section policy. Given a changed section policy, when reporting, writing and assignment APIs fetch context, then they resolve the same current section and surface missing/unauthorized failures. Scenario: Budgeted context. Given required editorial policy, when evidence is compacted, then policy is retained intact or the request fails explicitly.
